{"revisions":[{"path":"story.dek","text":"Official price growth has slowed, but the cumulative cost of living has outrun household income, leaving consumers squeezed and skeptical of the economic data."},{"path":"story.keyPoints[0]","text":"Headline inflation has moderated from its 2022 peaks but remains above the Federal Reserve's target."},{"path":"story.keyPoints[1]","text":"Core prices have climbed faster than real median household income over the past five years."},{"path":"story.keyPoints[2]","text":"Consumer sentiment has fallen sharply, tracking the gap between official data and what people actually pay."},{"path":"story.blocks[0].text","text":"The grocery receipt and the news bulletin have stopped agreeing with each other.
